episodes.synopsis: While getting drenched in the rain, Fuji encounters an "abandoned dog" on the street and brings it home.
episodes.title: Rainy Days

episodes.synopsis: Fuji and her "dog" go on a walk with her neighbor Kii and her dog Kinako. Then Fuji's dad, Tatsuo, shows up.
episodes.title: The Evening Sun

episodes.synopsis: Fuji's friends from school, Ren and Mimi, visit her for a gyoza party.
episodes.title: Friends

episodes.synopsis: You, Fuji, Kii, and Fuji's parents go to the summer festival, and You disappears.
episodes.title: Summer Festival

episodes.synopsis: Fuji meets manga artist Tokaku Arata in a video meeting. You and Fuji meet Medaka and Noriko on their walk.
episodes.title: The Same Moon

episodes.synopsis: Fuji's twin brother, Teru, and his pregnant wife, Wako, leave their cat at Fuji's.
episodes.title: The Cat and Pumpkins

episodes.synopsis: Fuji encounters a writer's block and cannot get out of it.
episodes.title: It's Nothing

episodes.synopsis: Fuji hears You cry for the first time.
episodes.title: The Cry

episodes.synopsis: It turns out that Fuji doesn't want others to know she's a writer.
episodes.title: A Secret

episodes.synopsis: Fuji reaches out to Ren for support as she struggles with writer's block.
episodes.title: A River That Cannot Be Crossed

episodes.synopsis: Fuji gets Mimi and Ren to help out with her spring cleaning.
episodes.title: New Things, Old Things

episodes.synopsis: Fuji thinks of reasons she loves the rain.
episodes.title: I Can Hear the Sound of the Rain
